claim: Determine what worker completion and parsed handoff fields mean under controlled provider exits and output formats.
evidenceClass: Source-informed local execution of unchanged Bash wrapper and Node collector; provider replaced by a deterministic fake executable.

cases.input: exit 0, exact headings and dash bullets with successful report
cases.expected: wrapper exit 0; completed status; summary/validation/risks parsed

cases.input: exit 0, exact headings and dash bullets explicitly reporting failed verification and incomplete work
cases.expected: wrapper exit 0; completed status; failure and risk text still present in parsed handoff

cases.input: exit 0, prose under numbered section labels rather than recognized headings/bullets
cases.expected: wrapper exit 0; completed status; source handoff retained but parsed summary/validation/risks empty

cases.input: exit 7 with diagnostic stderr and partial final-output file
cases.expected: wrapper exit 1; failed status; generic failure handoff, not the partial output; stderr observable in captured process output
wrapper exit 1; failed status; fake provider not invoked

scope: Temporary Git repository, fake HOME, restricted PATH with fake codex first, temporary files; no tmux, real Codex, model, network, installation, user data or concurrent execution.
oracle: Literal process exit, unchanged collector output, exact source file contents and fake invocation log; no claim about task quality or actual model behavior.
criteriaTiming: Written before running the experiment, after inspecting source. Matching predictions are not product-safety passes.
